ei.title: Intelligence and the Rise of Leisure
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Intelligence and the Rise of Leisure

fullPassage: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time. Finding food and drink, keeping warm and clean, avoiding predators, migrating and reproducing use up all their energies. If they do have any time to spare, they spend it resting or sleeping. Only very young animals, under the protection of their parents, have enough surplus energy to engage in lively bouts of play. This was also true for our early ancestors. The constant search for food would have put heavy demands upon them. But as they slowly evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed. The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence. They used brain not brawn to kill their prey. At the end of the long hunting era, before they turned to farming, they were already enjoying some degree of affluence. In certain regions, at particular times of year, the prey was sufficiently plentiful and their hunting techniques sufficiently advanced for them to experience a remarkable degree of prosperity. They had time on their hands.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① a remarkable degree of prosperity: 놀라운 수준의 번영을 경험했다

✅ ① a remarkable degree of prosperity: 사냥감이 충분하고 기술이 발달하여 번영을 경험했다는 맥락 ← 정답
❌ ② an inevitable decline in population: 인구 감소는 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ③ a growing dependence on agriculture: 아직 농경 전환 이전 시기
❌ ④ a severe shortage of natural resources: 자원 부족과 반대 — 풍요를 누림

det.analysis: 'They used brain not brawn to kill their prey.' — 완력(brawn) 대신 두뇌(brain)를 사용했다
det.tip: brain not brawn = 완력이 아닌 두뇌

questions.passage: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time. Finding food and drink, keeping warm and clean, avoiding predators, migrating and reproducing use up all their energies. If they do have any time to spare, they spend it resting or sleeping. Only very young animals, under the protection of their parents, have enough surplus energy to engage in lively bouts of play. This was also true for our early ancestors. The constant search for food would have put heavy demands upon them. But as they slowly evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed. The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence. They used brain not brawn to kill their prey. At the end of the long hunting era, before they turned to farming, they were already enjoying some degree of affluence. In certain regions, at particular times of year, the prey was sufficiently plentiful and their hunting techniques sufficiently advanced for them to experience a remarkable degree of prosperity. They had time on their hands.

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 지능 발달 → 효율적 사냥 → 여가 시간 탄생
det.analysis:
✅ ① 지능 발달로 인한 여가 시간 탄생: 본문 전체 흐름 — 동물은 생존에 바쁨 → 인류는 지능 발달 → 효율적 사냥 → 여가 탄생 ← 정답
❌ ② 농업 기술: 농경은 마지막에 잠깐 언급, 주제 아님
❌ ③ 야생 동물 생존 전략: 도입부 배경일 뿐 주제 아님
❌ ④ 계급 구조: 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: 제목 'Intelligence and the Rise of Leisure'

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 지능 발달 → 효율적 사냥 → 여유(time on their hands)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 생존 본능 약화: 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ② 농경 시작과 여가: 본문은 농경 이전에 이미 풍요 누렸다고 서술
✅ ③ 지능 발달 + 효율적 사냥 → 여유: 본문 핵심 요지 ← 정답
❌ ④ 포식자 회피 + 집단생활: 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: They had time on their hands = 여유 시간이 생겼다

ch: 동물의 생존 본능은 진화 과정에서 약화되었다.
인류의 여가는 농경의 시작과 함께 본격화되었다.
인류는 지능을 발달시켜 효율적으로 사냥함으로써 여유를 얻었다.
초기 인류는 포식자를 피하기 위해 집단생활을 시작했다.
